scope: Read-only Addressables build artifact audit. No Unity launch or Assets edits.
method: For each reported duplicate AssetGuid + LocalIdentifierInFile, extra bytes = sum(SerializedSize + StreamedSize across copies) minus maximum single-copy size. This is uncompressed object accounting, not compressed file savings, native heap or VRAM.

comparison.compressedScope: Five environment bundles plus shared environment bundle; excludes M4 and Addressables builtin/script bundles.

pvs.interpretation: BuildLayout records the native PVS type as AssetType=0 with zero size. Its listed identity and source bake payload are verified, but this does not measure runtime PVS residency or prove camera culling works.

limits: The latest build adds a jointly baked PVS absent from the baseline, so this is the observed net build-size change, not an isolated compression-only experiment.
Built-in player/core dependencies are not fully represented by an Addressables layout. Separate core copies, including native PVS and collision meshes, are not counted as eliminated.
The shared group stays loaded while any dependent environment remains loaded. Region addresses, scene splitting and handle ownership are retained.
No GPU/CPU frame-time or VRAM conclusion is made. Architecture/large opaque rocks are PVS occluders; trees and manually instanced grass are not claimed to benefit from this bake.
